name: Göbeklitepe synthetic village
note: Density and agent positions come from pedsim. The field client selects and reweights these packed bands. It does not run a second model. Packed 900 steps so agents can finish origin→destination trips.

properties.access_notes: Stay on the visitor paths and the public approach road. The excavation is fenced; do not enter it.
properties.safety_notes: Heat, no shade on the ridge, carry water. Do not fly a drone without a permit.

properties.access_notes: Public approach only. Start and end are outside the fenced excavation.
